document.name: ActionsFixtureRow
document.documentation:
Row of the Kitchen Sink actions fixture. The fixture's rows grid links each row to the Run From Row action, which this document's edit view declares out of its action panel, so the link is the action's only trigger.
SmartClient shows the link from the link's own condition, rowLinkHidden, evaluated for the row, and ignores the action's. PrimeFaces shows it from the action's conditions, rowActionDisabled here, evaluated for the row, and ignores the link's.
The edit view also offers Export From Row, so that an export requested while zoomed in on a row can be checked against the row's view.

boolean.name: hideLink
boolean.description: Hides this row's Run From Row link in the fixture's rows grid in SmartClient.

boolean.name: disableRowAction
boolean.description: Disables Run From Row's link in the fixture's rows grid in PrimeFaces, which applies the row action's conditions to the link. SmartClient, and the server check, apply only the link's own condition.

text.name: outcome
text.description: Whether Run From Row ran for this row.
